02 / Photography

Photography

I love preserving a moment that would otherwise pass: a shift in light, an animal’s movement, or a small detail in a familiar place. Photography gives me a reason to slow down, notice, and keep a piece of that moment.

03 / Hobbies

Scrapbooking & Yoga

Paper & Collage

Scrapbooking

I like making art from “trash.” This page brings together newspaper I found on the bus, my lunch bag, receipts, and packaging. I love the tactile puzzle of tearing, arranging, and finding how the pieces fit together.

Movement & Mindfulness

Yoga

Yoga helps me manage stress and stay present alongside classes, research, and rehearsals. I’m working toward my MBSR certification in November 2026.

Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction combines meditation and mindful movement.
